scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You want a Solution? Hmm, give me 50 Zeny and at least 1 Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你想要药水吗？嗯，给我50 Zeny和至少1个空试管。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Hey! You don't have enough money to cover my 50 Zeny charge.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
嘿！你的钱不够支付我50 Zeny的费用。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can't carry solutions without a bottle! Bring me an Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
没有瓶子你没法装药水！给我带一个空试管来。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
Would you like a Solution? Then please give me 50 Zeny and at least 1 Empty Test Tube.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
你想要药水吗？请给我50 Zeny和至少1个空试管。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
I'm sorry, but you don't have enough money to cover the 50 Zeny fee.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
很抱歉，你的钱不够支付50 Zeny的费用。

scripts.text:
[Mage Guildsman]
You can't carry liquids without using a bottle. Bring an Empty Test Tube the next time you see me.
scripts.translation:
[魔法师公会成员]
没有瓶子你没法装液体。下次见到我时请带一个空试管来。
